This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

Milwaukee M18 18V brushless cordless angle grinder is engineered for demanding metalworking and cutting tasks on site. The compact, lightweight tool provides 11,000 rpm no-load speed to nsure efficient material removal and precise cuts, ideal for plumbers, fabricators, and general builders. Key safety features include a safety clutch to protect against kickback injuries and a non-lockable paddle switch with line-lock-out function to prevent unexpected start-ups. The integrated FIXTEC system allows for quick, tool-free disc changes, enhancing productivity. The angle grinder is compatible with all Milwaukee M18 batteries for versatile use across various job requirements.
